record: GBA-020 SPEC-045 implementation, fixture verification, and LeafGreen frontier

source_categories.source_observation: mGBA semantics are recorded in KNO-001 SRC-41 at fixed source commit 143adf5aa2a60c6036810b0cd72445e13d74b0e6.
source_categories.fixture_execution: The synthetic B48-B6A package was compiled and run in O0 and O2 on macOS arm64.
source_categories.static_inference: LeafGreen result is compiler discovery output and encoding analysis only; it is not guest execution or decompilation.

gate.cpu_measurement_note: The 3.67 value is derived from (user + system) / wall for the whole gate. It is not per-process or instantaneous telemetry and does not establish sustained saturation. No before/after throughput comparison was run in this record.

limits: The fixtures prove only the contracted synthetic cases and macOS arm64 execution.
This model has no IRQ delivery or event sources; nonzero initial latches from direct external block callers are outside the contract.
LeafGreen discovery stops before LLVM emission and native linking, so this attempt did not use the configured link threads.
CFG discovery and LLVM module emission for one ROM remain serial in the current compile path.
